Between late 2016 and 2020, much of my exploratory work in computational
philology lived as loose Jupyter notebooks in two GitHub repositories —
[`ll-experiments`](https://github.com/diyclassics/ll-experiments) (Latin,
mostly via CLTK) and
[`perseus-experiments`](https://github.com/diyclassics/perseus-experiments)
(Greek and Perseus/treebank data). This collection gathers those notebooks as
they are ported here: each one is edited for clarity, updated to current tools
(LatinCy and friends where it makes sense), and annotated with a note pointing
back to its original publication.

The posts below carry the `from-the-archives` tag and are listed newest-first as
they are re-published.

::: {#collected-notebooks}
:::
